# Audit rules

URL: https://seowatcher.io/en/docs/audit-rules/

> The list of 202 rules the site audit checks. For each rule you find what it means and how to fix it.

The site audit checks every page, and the site as a whole, against 202 rules: 13 critical, 93 warnings and 96 info. That is the number of rule IDs in the app's rule list, and each one is a row in the tables below. **Critical** (13 rules): Google cannot see or understand the page, or visitors cannot reach the site, so fix these first. **Warning** (64 rules in that table): they slowly lower rankings and clicks. **Info** (62 rules in that table): small opportunities to improve. The **Additional checks** section below lists 63 more rules (29 warnings, 34 info). In the score, critical counts 40, warning 15 and info 3, and the number of pages a rule affects counts too.

The table gives the rule name shown on screen, what it means and the first step to fix it. The full fix text is on the finding card on screen. The last column is the rule ID, which shows up in the CSV file and in assistant answers.

## Common terms

- **canonical**: a way to tell Google "this is the main address".
- **noindex**: a tag that hides a page from search.
- **hreflang**: the language version tag. It points to the same page in other languages.
- **meta description**: the gray summary under the title in a search result.
- **structured data** (JSON-LD): a hidden note that tells Google what the page is (a product, an article and so on). It can add extras to the search result, such as stars or an image (rich result).
- **robots.txt**: the file that tells Google which pages it may visit. A "Disallow" line forbids access.
- **sitemap**: the list of pages on your site. **lastmod**: the date the page last changed.
- **redirect**: sending visitors from one address to another.
- **user agent**: the name a browser or crawler gives itself.
- **title** (title tag): the title shown in the tab and in search. **H1**: the main heading of the page. **alt text**: a short text that says what an image shows.
- **nofollow**: a tag that says "do not follow this link". **head**: the top part of the page source.
- **LCP**: how long the main content of the page takes to appear. **CLS**: content shifting while the page loads. **INP**: how long the page takes to respond to a click.
- **Lighthouse**: Google's page-testing tool. **SSL certificate**: the document that makes your site https (a secure address).

## Critical

| Rule                                               | What it means                                                                                                      | How to fix                                                                                         | ID                          |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Crawler was blocked                                | Your site's bot protection stopped the crawler. Google may be blocked too.                                         | In your firewall, allow the "seotracker-audit" user agent.                                         | blocked-page                |
| Server error (5xx)                                 | The page returns a server error. Google removes such pages from search.                                            | Find the error for this address in the server logs and fix it.                                     | server-error                |
| robots.txt file returns a server error             | If Google cannot read the file, it may stop crawling the site completely.                                          | Fix the error. Check that the robots.txt address opens normally.                                   | robots-txt-server-error     |
| Start address is blocked by robots.txt             | The address the crawl starts from is forbidden in robots.txt.                                                      | If it should be crawled, delete the matching "Disallow" line.                                      | robots-txt-blocks-start-url |
| Page in the sitemap does not open                  | A page you told Google exists returns an error.                                                                    | If the page should exist, fix the error. If not, remove it from the sitemap.                       | sitemap-broken-page         |
| A file the page needs is blocked by robots.txt     | Google cannot reach the design or code file it needs to display the page.                                          | Delete the rule in robots.txt that covers these files.                                             | blocked-resource            |
| Insecure file on a secure page                     | A secure (https) page loads a file from an insecure (http) address. Browsers block this.                           | Change the file's address so it starts with https.                                                 | mixed-content-resource      |
| A hidden page is named as the main address         | The page named as the main address is hidden from search. The two cancel each other out.                           | Remove noindex from the target page, or make the main address the page's own address.              | canonical-to-noindex        |
| Google treats the page as empty (soft 404)         | Google treats the page as "does not exist" and keeps it out of search.                                             | If the page really does not exist, return a 404 or 410 error code. If it exists, add real content. | google-soft-404             |
| Google cannot crawl the page because of robots.txt | Google's answer: robots.txt blocks it.                                                                             | Find and delete the "Disallow" line in robots.txt that covers this address.                        | google-blocked-by-robots    |
| robots.txt closes the whole site to Google         | robots.txt forbids Google from crawling the home page (usually a "Disallow: /" line). Google won't crawl the site. | Delete the "Disallow: /" line, or limit it to the folders that should stay hidden.                 | robots-disallow-all         |
| http address doesn't redirect to https             | The site's http address opens without moving to the secure version. Browsers say "Not secure".                     | Turn on "Force HTTPS" in your hosting panel, or add a permanent (301) redirect.                    | no-https-redirect           |
| SSL certificate is about to expire                 | The certificate expires in less than 14 days. After that, browsers open the site behind a full-page warning.       | Renew the certificate now. If renewal is automatic, find out why it didn't run.                    | ssl-expiring-very-soon      |

## Warning

| Rule                                                                              | What it means                                                                                                                  | How to fix                                                                                                                                               | ID                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Hit the request limit (429)                                                       | The site told the crawler "too many requests".                                                                                 | Raise the request limit on the server, or exempt "seotracker-audit" from the limit.                                                                      | rate-limited-page                      |
| Crawl stopped early: request limit                                                | The crawl stopped when the wait passed 30 minutes.                                                                             | Restart the audit once the site's request limit resets.                                                                                                  | crawl-rate-limited                     |
| Broken internal link                                                              | A link on your site goes to a page that does not open.                                                                         | Point the link to the right address, or delete it.                                                                                                       | broken-internal-link                   |
| Page returns an error when opened (4xx)                                           | The page returns an error such as "not found".                                                                                 | If the page should exist, publish it again. If not, delete the links that go to it.                                                                      | broken-page                            |
| Redirect chain                                                                    | The address redirects several times before it reaches the final page.                                                          | Redirect the first address, and the links to it, straight to the final page.                                                                             | redirect-chain                         |
| Redirect loop                                                                     | The address redirects to itself or in a circle.                                                                                | Follow the redirect rules and break the loop.                                                                                                            | redirect-loop                          |
| Page that no page links to                                                        | The page exists only in the sitemap. Google gives it little value.                                                             | Link to it from the menu, from related posts or from a category page.                                                                                    | orphan-page                            |
| robots.txt could not be reached                                                   | The file did not respond at all.                                                                                               | Open the robots.txt address in a browser and check that it responds.                                                                                     | robots-txt-unreachable                 |
| robots.txt is over the 500 KB limit                                               | Google does not read the end of the file.                                                                                      | Shorten the file.                                                                                                                                        | robots-txt-truncated                   |
| Page in the sitemap redirects                                                     | The sitemap has an address that redirects to another address.                                                                  | Put the final address it redirects to in the sitemap.                                                                                                    | sitemap-redirect-page                  |
| Address in the sitemap is blocked by robots.txt                                   | The sitemap says "come", robots.txt says "do not come".                                                                        | If it should show up in search, remove the block. If not, delete it from the sitemap.                                                                    | sitemap-disallowed-page                |
| Sitemap file is too large to read                                                 | The file is over the 10 MB limit.                                                                                              | Split the sitemap into parts.                                                                                                                            | sitemap-too-large                      |
| Sitemap has more than 50,000 addresses                                            | Google accepts at most 50,000 addresses in one file.                                                                           | Split the file into parts under 50,000. Join the parts with one main sitemap file.                                                                       | sitemap-too-many-urls                  |
| A sitemap file could not be read                                                  | No addresses could be read from a file that robots.txt or a sitemap index points to. The details name the file and the reason. | Open the address in a browser; if it errors or redirects, publish the file at the right address. A timeout is usually temporary, so run the audit again. | sitemap-unreadable                     |
| Sitemap has a lastmod date in the future                                          | The date is later than today. Google stops trusting the dates.                                                                 | Check what generates the dates.                                                                                                                          | sitemap-lastmod-future                 |
| The sitemap lists addresses on another site                                       | The sitemap lists addresses on another domain. Google usually ignores them.                                                    | Publish the sitemap on the site the addresses belong to, or fix the site address in the setting that generates it.                                       | sitemap-off-host-urls                  |
| Page opens over insecure http                                                     | The page is not secure (https).                                                                                                | Ask your hosting company to turn on the free SSL certificate.                                                                                            | not-https                              |
| Title tag is missing                                                              | The page has no title tag (title).                                                                                             | Add a title that describes the topic and is specific to the page. 50-60 characters is a good length.                                                     | missing-title                          |
| Meta description is missing                                                       | The gray summary in the search result is missing.                                                                              | Write a description that summarizes the page and makes people click.                                                                                     | missing-meta-description               |
| Images without alt text                                                           | Nothing says what the images show.                                                                                             | Write a short alt text for every image that carries meaning.                                                                                             | images-missing-alt                     |
| More than one title tag on the page                                               | There are two title tags. Google picks one at random.                                                                          | Search the page source for "title" and keep only one.                                                                                                    | multiple-titles                        |
| More than one different meta description on the page                              | There are two descriptions.                                                                                                    | Search the page source for name="description" and keep only one.                                                                                         | multiple-meta-descriptions             |
| Title tag is placeholder text                                                     | The title is something like "Home" or "Untitled".                                                                              | Write your own title that describes the topic of the page.                                                                                               | placeholder-title                      |
| Duplicate title                                                                   | Several pages use the same title.                                                                                              | Give each page its own title that describes its own content.                                                                                             | duplicate-title                        |
| Duplicate main heading (H1)                                                       | Several pages have the same main heading.                                                                                      | Write a different H1 for each page.                                                                                                                      | duplicate-h1                           |
| Duplicate meta description                                                        | Several pages use the same description.                                                                                        | Write each page its own description, or delete the repeated one.                                                                                         | duplicate-meta-description             |
| Duplicate page content                                                            | Two pages carry the same text.                                                                                                 | Choose the main page. Link the other one to it with canonical.                                                                                           | duplicate-content                      |
| Main address declarations contradict each other                                   | The HTML and the server response name different main addresses.                                                                | Choose one main address and state it in one place only.                                                                                                  | canonical-conflict                     |
| Page named as the main address does not open                                      | The page named as the main address returns an error.                                                                           | Change the main address to a working page, or publish the target again.                                                                                  | canonical-to-broken                    |
| A page that redirects is named as the main address                                | The main address is an address that redirects to another page.                                                                 | Make the main address the final page it redirects to.                                                                                                    | canonical-to-redirect                  |
| Google sees a hide tag (noindex) on the page                                      | Google's answer: it saw noindex on the page.                                                                                   | Compare the page source with what Google sees. A plugin or a template may be adding the tag.                                                             | google-blocked-by-meta                 |
| Google chose a different main address                                             | Google did not accept your main address.                                                                                       | Look at the address Google chose. Either make it the main address, or make the two pages clearly different.                                              | google-chose-different-canonical       |
| Language version code (hreflang) is invalid                                       | A code that does not exist was written, such as "en-UK".                                                                       | Write the right code. For the United Kingdom it is "en-GB".                                                                                              | hreflang-invalid-code                  |
| Page does not list itself among the language versions (hreflang)                  | The page lists the other languages but not itself.                                                                             | Add the page's own address, with its own language code, to the list.                                                                                     | hreflang-missing-self                  |
| Page turns off its links with a robots directive                                  | The page has turned off following its links (nofollow).                                                                        | If you want its links to be followed, delete the "nofollow" text.                                                                                        | nofollow-page                          |
| Paginated page points to the first page as its main address                       | Page 2 names page 1 as its main address. Google ignores page 2.                                                                | Make each page's main address its own address.                                                                                                           | paginated-canonical-to-first-page      |
| Language versions do not link back to each other (hreflang)                       | Page A points to B but B does not point to A.                                                                                  | Add a hreflang line to page B that points to A.                                                                                                          | hreflang-no-return-tag                 |
| Language version points to a page that does not open or is removed from the index | The language version it points to returns an error or is hidden from search.                                                   | Look at the address in the details. Fix it or take it off the list.                                                                                      | hreflang-target-broken                 |
| Main address (canonical) points to another domain or to http                      | The main address points to another site or to an insecure (http) address.                                                      | Unless you did it on purpose, make the main address the page's own https address.                                                                        | canonical-cross-host-or-http           |
| Structured data block is broken                                                   | The structured data block (JSON-LD) cannot be read.                                                                            | Paste the block into a JSON checker. Usually there is an extra comma.                                                                                    | structured-data-invalid-json           |
| Google crawled it but did not index it                                            | Google's answer: it did not find the content good enough.                                                                      | In Google's "URL Inspection Tool", check for noindex, blocked files or content that looks empty.                                                         | google-crawled-not-indexed             |
| Google found it but has not crawled it yet                                        | Google knows the address and has put it in the queue.                                                                          | Waiting is usually enough. Link to it from pages that are crawled often.                                                                                 | google-discovered-not-indexed          |
| Google saw duplicate content and no main address is set                           | Google found a copy of the page and you did not set a main address.                                                            | Add a canonical that points to the main address on every page in the group of copies.                                                                    | google-duplicate-no-canonical          |
| Google does not know this address at all                                          | The address has never reached Google.                                                                                          | Add it to the sitemap and submit the sitemap to Search Console.                                                                                          | google-url-unknown                     |
| Google found an error in the structured data                                      | A field is missing in the markup written for a rich result.                                                                    | Open the address in Google's Rich Results Test. It shows the missing field there.                                                                        | google-rich-results-invalid            |
| Page declares main addresses that contradict each other                           | The page has more than one canonical tag.                                                                                      | Decide which one is right. Turn off the plugin that produces the other.                                                                                  | multiple-canonical-tags                |
| Main content of the page loads late (LCP)                                         | The largest element arrives later than 4 seconds.                                                                              | Look at the largest element in the PageSpeed report. It is usually an image. Make it smaller and convert it to WebP.                                     | cwv-lcp-poor                           |
| Content shifts while the page loads (CLS)                                         | The shift score is greater than 0.25.                                                                                          | Give images and embedded boxes a width and a height.                                                                                                     | cwv-cls-poor                           |
| Page responds slowly to clicks (INP)                                              | The response to a click takes longer than 500 milliseconds.                                                                    | Find the scripts that slow the page most. Delay them or remove them.                                                                                     | cwv-inp-poor                           |
| Google's SEO audit score is low                                                   | The Lighthouse SEO score is below 90.                                                                                          | Open the page in PageSpeed Insights. Look at the failed checks in the SEO section.                                                                       | lighthouse-seo-low                     |
| Site opens both with and without www                                              | Both addresses open the page and neither redirects to the other. Google sees two copies of the same content.                   | Pick one as the main address and permanently (301) redirect the other to it.                                                                             | www-and-apex-both-serve                |
| Missing page returns 200 instead of 404                                           | An address that doesn't exist answers "OK" (200). Google treats this as a soft 404.                                            | Make your error page return a 404 status code. Its content can stay the same.                                                                            | soft-404-on-missing-page               |
| Start page HTML is larger than 2 MB                                               | Google only processes the first 2 MB of HTML and ignores the rest.                                                             | Move large embedded data into separate files. Split long lists into pages.                                                                               | html-too-large                         |
| Server is slow to send its first response (TTFB)                                  | The start page's first byte arrived after more than 800 milliseconds.                                                          | Turn on page caching, find slow plugins, and use a CDN close to your visitors.                                                                           | slow-ttfb                              |
| Page blocks zooming                                                               | The viewport tag turns off zooming on phones. Visitors with poor eyesight can't enlarge the text.                              | Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.                                                                                         | viewport-zoom-disabled                 |
| Links whose address is "javascript:"                                              | Google can't follow these links, so it can't find their pages this way.                                                        | If it goes to a page, write the real address. If it performs an action, use a button.                                                                    | javascript-href-links                  |
| Form fields without labels                                                        | A screen reader can't say what belongs in the field.                                                                           | Give every field a visible label or an aria-label.                                                                                                       | form-input-without-label               |
| Page's HTML structure is too large                                                | The page has more than 1,500 HTML elements. It slows things down, especially on phones.                                        | Load hidden content only when needed. Cut unnecessary wrapper layers.                                                                                    | dom-too-large                          |
| Near-duplicate content                                                            | These pages' main content differs by only a few words. Google may pick one and not show the others.                            | Give each page content of its own, or merge the pages and add a canonical.                                                                               | near-duplicate-content                 |
| Required properties missing in structured data                                    | Fields Google requires for this type (such as Product or FAQPage) are missing. No rich result appears.                         | Add the missing fields. Check the result in Google's Rich Results Test.                                                                                  | structured-data-required-props-missing |
| Analytics id on the pages doesn't match the connected property                    | Visitor data is most likely going to a different Analytics property.                                                           | Replace the tag on the pages with the right id, or connect the right property in Settings.                                                               | analytics-id-mismatch                  |
| No HSTS header                                                                    | The header that tells browsers "always use https for this site" isn't sent.                                                    | Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to the server response.                                                                                         | missing-hsts                           |
| SSL certificate expires in less than 30 days                                      | According to public certificate logs, the certificate expires within 30 days.                                                  | Check in your hosting panel that automatic renewal is on.                                                                                                | ssl-expiring-soon                      |
| Domain expires in less than 30 days                                               | If it isn't renewed, the site and email stop. Someone else could register the domain.                                          | Renew the domain and turn on auto-renewal.                                                                                                               | domain-expiring-soon                   |

## Info

| Rule                                                           | What it means                                                                                           | How to fix                                                                                       | ID                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| Server response is slow                                        | The server's first answer comes late.                                                                   | Look at server and database time. Turn on caching (keeping ready copies).                        | slow-response                             |
| Page in the sitemap points to another page as its main address | The sitemap has an address that is a copy.                                                              | Keep only main addresses in the sitemap.                                                         | sitemap-canonicalized-page                |
| Page in the sitemap is hidden from search results              | The sitemap has a page that is hidden from search.                                                      | If it should show up in search, remove noindex. If not, delete it from the sitemap.              | sitemap-noindex-page                      |
| Page is too deep in the site structure                         | The page is many clicks away from the home page.                                                        | Shorten the path with links from categories, menus or featured lists.                            | deep-page                                 |
| Sitemap has no lastmod dates at all                            | Google does not know the last change date.                                                              | In the setting that generates the sitemap, turn on lastmod for every address.                    | sitemap-lastmod-missing                   |
| robots.txt opens some paths only to Googlebot                  | These paths are closed to other bots, so the audit didn't crawl them. Google can.                       | Nothing needs to change. If there's no reason for it, make the rule the same for all bots.       | robots-googlebot-only-paths               |
| Internal link goes to a redirect                               | The link goes to an old address and redirects from there.                                               | Replace the link with the new address it redirects to.                                           | internal-link-to-redirect                 |
| Character encoding is not declared                             | Turkish characters may break in some browsers.                                                          | Add the line meta charset="utf-8" at the start of the head section.                              | missing-charset                           |
| Page address is too long                                       | The address is long and hard to read.                                                                   | Keep the address short and meaningful.                                                           | url-too-long                              |
| Address has capital letters or underscores                     | Two separate spellings of the same page can appear.                                                     | Write addresses in lowercase with hyphens.                                                       | url-uppercase-or-underscore               |
| H1 heading is missing                                          | The page has no main heading.                                                                           | Add a single H1 that describes the topic.                                                        | missing-h1                                |
| More than one H1 heading                                       | There is more than one main heading.                                                                    | Keep a single H1. Make the others H2 or H3.                                                      | multiple-h1                               |
| Page has almost no text                                        | The crawler found no text. The text may be loading later with JavaScript.                               | Check in the page source whether the text shows up.                                              | thin-content                              |
| Page has no links to anywhere else                             | A dead-end page: it goes nowhere else.                                                                  | Add links to related pages, to the parent category or to the home page.                          | no-outgoing-links                         |
| Title is too long                                              | Google cuts off anything after 60 characters.                                                           | Shorten the title to 50-60 characters. Put the important words first.                            | title-too-long                            |
| Title is too short                                             | The title does not describe the page.                                                                   | Write a title of 30-60 characters that says what you offer.                                      | title-too-short                           |
| Meta description is too long                                   | Google cuts off anything after 160 characters.                                                          | Put the main message first and shorten it to 70-160 characters.                                  | meta-description-too-long                 |
| Meta description is too short                                  | The description gives no reason to click.                                                               | Write 70-160 characters that summarize the page.                                                 | meta-description-too-short                |
| Heading levels are skipped                                     | It jumps from H1 straight to H3.                                                                        | Use headings in order: H1, H2, H3.                                                               | heading-order-skip                        |
| Mobile view tag (viewport) is missing                          | The page looks tiny on a phone.                                                                         | Add the viewport line to the head section.                                                       | missing-viewport                          |
| Page language is not declared                                  | It does not say what language the page is in (no lang on the html tag).                                 | For a Turkish page, write html lang="tr".                                                        | missing-lang                              |
| Images have no width and height                                | Content jumps while the page loads.                                                                     | Write the real size of the image on every img tag.                                               | images-missing-dimensions                 |
| Long text has no subheadings                                   | The long post is one single block.                                                                      | Split the text by topic. Give each section an H2 heading.                                        | no-subheadings                            |
| Image alt text is a file name                                  | The alt text is something like "IMG_1234.jpg".                                                          | In the alt text, write what is in the image.                                                     | alt-is-filename                           |
| Image alt text is too long                                     | The alt text is as long as a paragraph.                                                                 | Describe the image in one sentence. About 125 characters is enough.                              | alt-too-long                              |
| Main heading (H1) is too long                                  | The H1 is as long as a paragraph.                                                                       | Cut the H1 down to a short, one-sentence heading.                                                | h1-too-long                               |
| Internal links without text                                    | The link has no text or only an icon.                                                                   | Add visible text or an aria-label (a name hidden for screen readers).                            | empty-anchor-text                         |
| Meaningless link texts such as "click here"                    | The link text does not say where it goes.                                                               | Replace the link text with the topic of the target page.                                         | generic-anchor-text                       |
| Too many links on the page                                     | The page has hundreds of links.                                                                         | Limit the menu and the footer to the most important pages.                                       | too-many-links                            |
| Nofollow links to your own site's pages                        | A link to your own pages has nofollow.                                                                  | Delete rel="nofollow" from these links.                                                          | internal-nofollow-links                   |
| Page has no canonical (main address) tag                       | Google guesses the main address.                                                                        | Add a canonical line to the head section that points to the page's own full address.             | missing-canonical                         |
| Page is hidden from search results (noindex)                   | The page is hidden from search, on purpose or by mistake.                                               | If it should show up in search, remove noindex.                                                  | noindex-page                              |
| Page points to another page as its main address                | The page declares itself a copy.                                                                        | If it should show up in search under its own name, make the main address its own address.        | canonicalized-page                        |
| Language versions have no default version (x-default)          | There is no default version for visitors whose language does not match.                                 | Add an x-default line to the hreflang list.                                                      | hreflang-missing-x-default                |
| Google's answer about some pages is out of date                | Stored Google answers are older than 3 or 14 days.                                                      | On the **Index status** tab, press the "Check status on Google" button.                          | stale-google-verdicts                     |
| Site has no social media sharing tags (Open Graph)             | No image or title appears when it is shared.                                                            | In the template's head section, add og:title, og:description and an og:image of 1200x630 pixels. | open-graph-missing-site                   |
| Site has no structured data at all                             | A rich result cannot appear in search.                                                                  | Start with markup that fits the page type (such as Organization, Product or Article).            | structured-data-missing-site              |
| Google has not crawled this page for a long time               | Google's last visit is older than 90 days.                                                              | Link to it from pages that are crawled often. Make sure the page is in the sitemap.              | google-crawl-stale                        |
| Missing pages redirect to the home page                        | An address that doesn't exist goes to the home page. Google usually treats this as a soft 404.          | Show an error page that returns 404 for missing addresses. Redirect only pages that moved.       | not-found-redirects-home                  |
| Site icon (favicon) not found                                  | Mobile search shows a generic icon next to your site's name.                                            | Upload a square icon of at least 48x48 pixels and declare it in the head section.                | missing-favicon                           |
| robots.txt doesn't point to the sitemap                        | robots.txt has no "Sitemap:" line. Bing and other crawlers find the sitemap there.                      | Add a "Sitemap:" line with the sitemap's full address at the end of the file.                    | robots-missing-sitemap-line               |
| Some AI crawlers are blocked by robots.txt                     | Bots such as GPTBot and ClaudeBot are disallowed. This is a choice. Google Search isn't affected.       | If you did it on purpose, leave it. To appear in AI answers, allow the search bots.              | ai-crawlers-blocked                       |
| No llms.txt file (optional)                                    | The file proposed for AI assistants is missing. It isn't a standard and Google doesn't use it.          | If you like, put an /llms.txt listing your key pages at the site root.                           | missing-llms-txt                          |
| Start page arrived uncompressed                                | The page arrived without gzip or brotli compression.                                                    | Turn on compression on the server or CDN.                                                        | no-compression                            |
| Open Graph tags incomplete                                     | The title, description or image for the sharing card is missing.                                        | Add og:title, og:description and og:image together.                                              | og-incomplete                             |
| No X (Twitter) card tag                                        | On X the link may show as a plain address without a card.                                               | Add a twitter:card tag (summary_large_image) to the head section.                                | twitter-card-missing                      |
| Title tag and H1 are identical                                 | Not an error, but one of two separate chances is wasted.                                                | Write the title for the search result and the H1 for the reader on the page.                     | title-equals-h1                           |
| Title may be cut off in search results                         | The title is short, but wide letters push it past about 580 pixels.                                     | Shorten the title, or write capitalised words in normal case.                                    | title-pixel-too-wide                      |
| Unnecessary meta keywords tag                                  | Google doesn't use this tag at all.                                                                     | Remove it from the template or from your SEO plugin's settings.                                  | meta-keywords-present                     |
| External links open in a new tab without noopener              | A best-practice note. Current browsers already do this on their own.                                    | Add rel="noopener" to these links.                                                               | blank-target-without-noopener             |
| Images further down load immediately                           | More than six images below the first screen load as soon as the page opens.                             | Add loading="lazy" to them. Don't add it to the main image on the first screen.                  | images-not-lazy                           |
| Images in older formats                                        | Three or more images are JPEG, PNG or GIF with no newer-format alternative.                             | Convert the images to WebP or AVIF.                                                              | images-legacy-format                      |
| Same id on several elements                                    | Form labels and in-page links may point to the wrong element.                                           | Make every id unique. If it's only for styling, use a class.                                     | duplicate-ids                             |
| HTML elements nested too deeply                                | The page has elements nested more than 32 levels deep.                                                  | Remove unnecessary wrapper layers from the template.                                             | dom-too-deep                              |
| Very little visible text compared with code                    | Visible text is less than a tenth of the HTML.                                                          | Move large inline code into separate files. Make sure the text is in the page source.            | low-text-ratio                            |
| Recommended properties missing in structured data              | Fields Google recommends for Article or Organization markup are missing. Rich results aren't blocked.   | Add the missing fields using information shown on the page. Not urgent.                          | structured-data-recommended-props-missing |
| No Google Analytics tag found on the pages                     | The HTML has no G-, GTM- or UA- id. If the tag loads later, ignore this finding.                        | Add the Analytics or Tag Manager code to the head section of every page.                         | analytics-tag-missing                     |
| No X-Content-Type-Options header                               | The browser may guess file types. It doesn't affect rankings.                                           | Add "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff" to the server responses.                                   | missing-x-content-type-options            |
| Page can be embedded in other sites' frames                    | Another site can put your page in an invisible frame (clickjacking).                                    | Add a "frame-ancestors 'self'" or "X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN" header.                          | missing-clickjacking-protection           |
| No Referrer-Policy header                                      | Not urgent. The header decides how much of your address is shared when visitors leave for another site. | Add a "Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin" header.                                 | missing-referrer-policy                   |
| No SPF record on the domain                                    | Others can send fake email in your name. It doesn't affect SEO directly.                                | Add the SPF record your email provider recommends to DNS as a TXT record.                        | missing-spf                               |
| No DMARC record on the domain                                  | Nothing says what to do with email that fails verification. It doesn't affect SEO directly.             | Add a TXT record named \_dmarc to DNS. Start with p=none.                                        | missing-dmarc                             |

## Additional checks

These rules come from the Lighthouse report of the page speed measurement, from the pages' HTML, and from optional external requests. The severity column shows which group a rule counts in.

| Rule                                                           | Severity | What it means                                          | How to fix                                                | ID                          |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| Files are blocking the page's first render                     | Warning  | CSS and scripts delay the first render.                | Add defer to scripts the first screen doesn't need.       | lh-render-blocking          |
| The page loads JavaScript it doesn't use                       | Warning  | JavaScript that never runs is downloaded.              | Remove unused plugins and tags.                           | lh-unused-javascript        |
| Images are downloaded larger than they need to be              | Warning  | Images are downloaded larger than needed.              | Convert to WebP/AVIF, compress and resize.                | lh-image-delivery           |
| The page redirects before it opens                             | Warning  | There are redirects before the page opens.             | Point links at the final address.                         | lh-document-redirects       |
| The page is sent uncompressed                                  | Warning  | HTML is sent uncompressed.                             | Turn on gzip or Brotli compression.                       | lh-text-compression         |
| The page's main image is marked to load late                   | Warning  | The main image has loading="lazy".                     | Remove lazy from the main image on the first screen.      | lh-lcp-lazy-loaded          |
| Some text has too little color contrast                        | Warning  | Text doesn't stand out enough from its background.     | Ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast.                           | lh-a11y-color-contrast      |
| Images are missing alternative text (Lighthouse)               | Warning  | Images without alt text in the browser.                | Write alt text for meaningful images.                     | lh-a11y-image-alt           |
| Form fields have no label (Lighthouse)                         | Warning  | Form fields have no label.                             | Link a <label> to each field.                             | lh-a11y-label               |
| Some links have no readable name                               | Warning  | Some links have no readable name.                      | Add text or aria-label.                                   | lh-a11y-link-name           |
| Some buttons have no readable name                             | Warning  | Some buttons have no readable name.                    | Add text or aria-label.                                   | lh-a11y-button-name         |
| The page has no title in the browser (Lighthouse)              | Warning  | No <title> in the browser.                             | Add a title to the HTML the server sends.                 | lh-a11y-document-title      |
| Zooming is blocked on phones (Lighthouse)                      | Warning  | The viewport setting blocks zoom.                      | Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale.                | lh-a11y-meta-viewport       |
| The page makes insecure (http) requests                        | Warning  | The page makes http requests.                          | Serve every file over https.                              | lh-is-on-https              |
| Some links can't be crawled (Lighthouse)                       | Warning  | There are links Google can't follow.                   | Give every link a real href.                              | lh-crawlable-anchors        |
| Google can't index the page (Lighthouse)                       | Warning  | Lighthouse found the page not indexable.               | Check robots.txt and noindex rules.                       | lh-is-crawlable             |
| robots.txt has invalid lines                                   | Warning  | robots.txt has invalid lines.                          | Fix lines to "Field: value" form.                         | lh-robots-txt               |
| hreflang tags are invalid (Lighthouse)                         | Warning  | hreflang tags are invalid.                             | Use valid language codes and full addresses.              | lh-hreflang                 |
| The canonical tag is invalid (Lighthouse)                      | Warning  | The canonical tag is invalid.                          | Keep one canonical pointing at the page's own address.    | lh-canonical                |
| Insecure image, video or frame on a secure page                | Warning  | http images, video or frames on an https page.         | Start the addresses with https.                           | mixed-content-media         |
| Form data is sent unencrypted                                  | Warning  | Form data goes to an http address.                     | Make the form's action https.                             | form-action-http            |
| The canonical tag is in the page body                          | Warning  | The canonical is in <body>; Google ignores it.         | Move the tag into <head>.                                 | canonical-outside-head      |
| Robots tags contradict each other                              | Warning  | Robots tags contradict each other.                     | Keep a single robots tag.                                 | robots-meta-conflict        |
| The page says "not found" but answers successfully             | Warning  | The page says "not found" but returns 200.             | Return 404 or 410 if the page doesn't exist.              | page-says-not-found         |
| Placeholder text (lorem ipsum) was left on the page            | Warning  | The page has lorem ipsum placeholder text.             | Replace it with real content.                             | lorem-ipsum-text            |
| A follow-on page of a paginated list is hidden from search     | Warning  | Page 2 and later of a list are noindex.                | Remove noindex, give each page its own canonical.         | paginated-page-noindex      |
| On a secure site, internal links go to http addresses          | Warning  | On an https site, internal links go to http.           | Write internal links with https or relative.              | internal-http-links         |
| A link to another site is broken                               | Warning  | A link to another site doesn't open.                   | Update or remove the link.                                | broken-external-link        |
| Image file is too large                                        | Warning  | An image file is over 200 KB.                          | Resize, compress, convert to WebP/AVIF.                   | image-file-too-large        |
| The page loads CSS it doesn't use                              | Info     | Style rules the page doesn't use are downloaded.       | Turn off unused stylesheets.                              | lh-unused-css               |
| JavaScript files aren't minified                               | Info     | JavaScript files aren't minified.                      | Turn on minification in your build tool or CDN.           | lh-unminified-javascript    |
| CSS files aren't minified                                      | Info     | CSS files aren't minified.                             | Turn on minification in your build tool or CDN.           | lh-unminified-css           |
| Files aren't kept in the browser long enough                   | Info     | Files have a short browser cache lifetime.             | Give unchanging files a long Cache-Control.               | lh-cache-policy             |
| The page's total download size is very large                   | Info     | The page's total size is over 2.5 MB.                  | Shrink the largest images, videos and scripts.            | lh-total-byte-weight        |
| The page structure built in the browser is very large          | Info     | The page structure built in the browser is very large. | Build hidden content only when needed.                    | lh-dom-size                 |
| The server is slow to answer (Lighthouse)                      | Info     | The server's first byte takes over 600 ms.             | Turn on page caching.                                     | lh-slow-server-response     |
| Text is invisible while fonts load                             | Info     | Text is invisible until fonts load.                    | Add font-display: swap.                                   | lh-font-display             |
| The page's main image isn't requested with priority            | Info     | The main image is discovered late or not prioritized.  | Put it in the HTML as an <img> with fetchpriority="high". | lh-lcp-not-prioritized      |
| Files are served over old HTTP/1.1                             | Info     | Files arrive over HTTP/1.1.                            | Turn on HTTP/2 on your server or CDN.                     | lh-modern-http              |
| Unneeded JavaScript is sent for old browsers                   | Info     | Unneeded code for old browsers is sent.                | Update your target browser setting.                       | lh-legacy-javascript        |
| Third-party code keeps the browser busy for a long time        | Info     | Third-party code holds the main thread over 0.5 s.     | Remove unneeded tags, defer the rest.                     | lh-third-parties            |
| Main content loading could be faster (LCP)                     | Info     | LCP is between 2.5 and 4 seconds.                      | Shrink the main image, turn off its lazy loading.         | cwv-lcp-needs-improvement   |
| Content shifts a little while loading (CLS)                    | Info     | CLS is between 0.1 and 0.25.                           | Give images dimensions, reserve ad space.                 | cwv-cls-needs-improvement   |
| Responses to taps could be faster (INP)                        | Info     | INP is between 200 and 500 ms (field data).            | Split long scripts that run on a click.                   | cwv-inp-needs-improvement   |
| The page's language isn't declared in the browser (Lighthouse) | Info     | No lang on the <html> element.                         | Add a language, e.g. <html lang="en">.                    | lh-a11y-html-has-lang       |
| Tap targets are too small or too close together                | Info     | Tap targets are small or too close.                    | Give targets at least 24×24 pixels.                       | lh-a11y-target-size         |
| Heading order skips levels in the browser (Lighthouse)         | Info     | Heading levels skip in the browser.                    | Use headings in order.                                    | lh-a11y-heading-order       |
| The browser logs errors while the page opens                   | Info     | Errors are logged to the console on load.              | Check the Console tab in Chrome.                          | lh-errors-in-console        |
| The page uses features browsers are removing                   | Info     | Deprecated browser features are used.                  | Update the old plugin or library.                         | lh-deprecations             |
